acceptance: Current delta capture uses the native resolved publication scope and includes older unpublished changes preceding the prior specification base, with exact baseline, range, source, tree, catalog and prior native archive identities.

Retained scope patterns expand solely to finite exact tracked membership at the bound relevant trees. The resulting inventory includes changed and deleted publication paths and preserves existing path and test bounds.

Missing, forged, stale or altered scope, source, catalog, inventory and prior archive evidence fails closed before sealing. No caller or model can select a baseline, supply mutable membership or invent paths.

Both historical closed binding shapes reconstruct their original selection and audit after remote advancement. Original raw responses, seals, archive identities and receipts remain unchanged and acquire no widened inventory or fresh approval.
Additive materialization preserves every prior criterion, selected module, fixture, mapping purpose and original criterion-to-module association while admitting only validated additions.

Native proposal, lifecycle and deterministic admission retain exact-source custody, failure preservation, complete-category requirements and existing publication boundaries. Tests use isolated synthetic repositories and fake reviewers without launching a model or changing deadlines.

An explicit send, submit, record, report or report-session feedback request authorizes exactly one privacy-minimized submission without requiring a further confirmation step, including its inspected and sanitized media.

Necessary in-scope discovered-bug reporting, evidence continuation and linking, and discussion follow-ups reuse the existing task authority without a redundant confirmation. Materially ambiguous targets and unrelated actions still require appropriate user input. Settings failures follow the same explicit reporting-request or necessary authorized-task bug-report rule; unsolicited reports outside that scope remain drafts with a Report this issue action, preserving privacy minimization, selected context and existing permissions.

Text and media minimization and inspection, fresh selected-context authorization, server-derived execution scope, uncertain-result no-replay and canonical reporter-completion semantics remain unchanged.

Every maintained canonical caller and reference and every generated client copy and archive applies the same authorization rule. Component versions, dependency pins and package composition remain valid and consistent, and no public API version, server permission, default or role changes.
Dependent skills whose only change is a component version pin keep unchanged record lookup routing, graph completion, compact default route presentation and focused student-workflow behavior.

Current app directory, public key, contact and scoped describe agreement propagate through registration construction, contract projection and callback readiness, preserving the exact returned same-app opaque organization URI, unchanged current schemas, real HTTPS host capability, strict legacy defaults and trusted origins, with no client route construction or new native alias.

Descriptor-bound payment-required (non-retryable 403) and entitlement-unavailable (retryable 503) service errors are preserved before lifecycle parsing with the closed, safe, correlated envelope and only the declared timing; the client infers no payment, separate product, trial eligibility, login recovery or uncertain registration replay, and the user-facing messages stay unchanged.

The workflow orchestrator skill declares its app discovery dependency at the actual current component version, with dependent skill and package version propagation and all generated client mirrors in parity; existing feedback behavior and complete package dependency closure are preserved.

The privacy scanner exempts only a complete SCP Git transport token with machine user git, exact host github.com, a bounded safe owner/repository.git path and closed boundaries; bare contacts, other users or hosts, credentials, queries, fragments and traversal stay flagged, and the original whole text is still scanned for phone and digest findings.

Publication CI keeps the unchanged closed profile and CI-only result for pure known Oracle ranges, routes known mixed Oracle and client ranges through the general native path, and fails closed on unknown Oracle-domain paths even when mixed; pinned runtime, dependency and model hashes are preserved with no provider credentials or fallback, and public Chroma tests honor the configured public Python with the existing local fallback.

General CI uses existing command coverage to verify exact native source, command and environment applicability, does not rerun genuinely covered commands, never counts missing, stale or foreign applicability as success, runs every required uncovered command and propagates its failure, and never fabricates native-only execution.

All Oracle public structural, Chroma, export, benchmark, runner and native-only proposal obligations run against a fresh immutable export of the final source using the existing verified locked runtime and model, with no automatic install or download.

Feedback explicit-request authorization behavior, source privacy and generated dependency parity are preserved, and synthetic credential-negative export fixtures are built deterministically so the package checker accepts the test source while runtime denial, exporter rejection and strict scanner rules stay exactly equivalent.

The closed-delta response schema binds every binding field through scalar property constants, all required keys and no additional properties, without an object-valued constant; the pinned schema validator accepts the exact binding and rejects missing, extra or tampered source, tree, origin, inventory and prior values, intake still independently checks complete binding equality, a non-feature delta carrying a design is refused rather than normalized, and feature design and test-plan checks remain intact, all without any provider call.

The integrated candidate keeps the published native execution path. Authenticated HTTPS stays the default. Native execution is selected only against a freshly advertised exact tool and schema for the selected authorized context. Lifecycle payloads are validated with the shared payload/date-time validator. Malformed results, mismatched contexts and error envelopes, including isError:true, fail closed. Optional locally discovered application evidence reaches the generic request builder while strict legacy defaults, descriptor/context agreement and refusal when no descriptor exists are preserved. The current registration transport and its returned URI stay unchanged, with no guessed application allowlist.

The fixed reviewer-policy inventory includes the imported generated-output proof module, appended after the unchanged original entries, for an exact 27-module source/mode/hash closure. Synthetic review workspaces copy that module, and the complete governing-text fixture inventory contains exactly 45 constructor inputs. Removing the module or altering its bytes or mode changes the policy binding or fails admission. Generated-output proof still exports the exact candidate, regenerates only the declared namespace within a bounded timeout, and grants deterministic coverage only for exact path/type/mode/blob matches.

Relocation admission keeps a canonical numbered hash chain with contiguous roots, cumulative retirement boundaries and the current Git directory identity. Retirement refuses live controllers and reviewer groups. Retired admissions never provide ownership, results, checkpoints or historical approval. Malformed, tampered, mixed-root or concurrently moved chains fail closed.

Interrupted cohorts keep an ordered, typed checkpoint journal. Observations are eligible only with intact preparation seals, real assigned paths and exact current input digests. Malformed or truncated records stop replay while earlier valid observations are preserved. Conflicting observations become UNREVIEWED. Interrupted work remains ERROR or INCOMPLETE and never issues approval.

Each review cohort receives complete authoritative governing texts with path and digest provenance, through bounded stdin forwarded by reviewer stubs. Non-crosscutting cohorts hold at most six primary paths, with at most three concurrent reviewers. Review-series, governance, performance and source-frontier runners execute all declared cases without skips or weakened assertions.

Release preparation, validation, publication and readback consistently use release/<major>.<minor>.<patch>. Legacy and malformed release refs are refused for new operations. Publication safety admits release push events against the main base, and publication admission executes all of its declared cases. Existing main/tag handling, exact-source CI, leased promotion, remote readback and existing remote legacy refs are preserved.

The scalar-binding helper and the production closed-delta response schema agree exactly. Every binding field is required. String fields are constrained to their exact scalar constants, null fields are constrained to null, and additional fields are rejected. Full-binding equality, null design for deep fixes, feature design semantics and historical audit replay are preserved. Tampered, missing, extra, baseline-moved, origin-moved and inventory-changed bindings are refused under both independently authored assertion sets.

The normal package patch bump propagates through every product and generated client, with exact skill dependency pins and byte parity between canonical and generated output. Both sets of authored guidance are preserved, including the CRM record-journey graph completion and presentation contract. No public API version, credential, authority, billing or installed-cache change is introduced.

The exact native selection admits every path in the complete current publication range, including the canonical native registration execution helper and each of its generated client mirrors. These paths come from the native publication-scope resolver without manual sealing, glob expansion or a caller-chosen baseline, and the canonical helper and every mirror keep identical, passing native registration behavior.

Every published history-integrity guard stays in force across proposal review, source review, gating and publication. Recorded spec bases, stamped origins, revision archives, review-series rounds and validation commits remain in required ancestry. Any reset, rebase, amend, force-push or replacement that would retire them is refused, and prepared ancestors stay valid through later descendant work.

The optional locally discovered application binding reaches the native registration builder with the exact current descriptor and context and the existing strict legacy defaults. Absent or mismatched descriptors fail closed, and current own-application HTTPS behavior is unchanged. The canonical producer and every client mirror are byte-identical. The before input is the published producer and its mirrors, the after input is the committed fixed bytes, and all test and fixture bytes are identical across that pair.

The package version is the next free ordinary patch above the actual published version. The occupied earlier release branch and its published source are preserved. No public API version, login, credential, grant, trust or tenant boundary, billing, or installed-cache change is introduced, and exact-source CI plus main readback remain required before publication.

When a TAP diagnostic comment continuation (newline followed by a '# ' comment prefix) splits a *_bytes key, its colon, or the boundary before its integer value, the value is still treated as a machine byte count and left out of the phone check. This must hold in the full operational-file scan and in the shared worker classifier, for every split position in the key and value boundary.

Phone, email and blocked-identifier findings stay detectable for: plain numeric or string contact fields, quoted byte values, malformed or non-TAP continuation markers, a missing key or colon, fractional or exponent values, extra adjacent values, and real email or digest matches. The original unmodified text is still scanned for every check except phone.

The fix adds no whole-log exclusion, arbitrary whitespace joining, digest allowlist, evidence modification or artifact cleanup. Changing the classifier source changes the privacy policy identity and invalidates earlier clean-cache results.
The published build definition stays checked: the build-definition test passes and the existing publication-safety admission of that definition is preserved.

Malformed input that repeats CRLF-plus-comment TAP continuations after a typed byte-count key, with the colon missing, completes in a separate child process within the existing one-second regression budget. The input is returned unchanged.

The ordinary-whitespace and exact TAP-continuation spacing alternatives in the typed byte-count slot are mutually exclusive. They accept exactly the whitespace and continuation syntax the earlier correction accepted, with no blanket normalization, partial scanning or timeout increase.

Valid repeated LF and CRLF continuations around a typed byte-count key still remove only the integer value from the phone view. Non-integer or malformed values stay unchanged, and every other privacy view still reads the original text.

Contact data and blocked identifiers placed next to a byte-count slot, whether well-formed or malformed, are still detected. All existing typed-slot and privacy worker cases keep their current results.

Portable feature test-plan binding enforces the same rules as the canonical binding: a 65536-byte raw plan limit, closed plan and row key sets, exact kind, design path and design digest, a nonempty feature, a nonempty list of safe runtime paths each inside the selected scope under the same fnmatch semantics, planned modules that are selected, unique and carry nonempty purposes and covers, and coverage that exactly equals the listed runtime paths. A finite synthetic parity matrix shows that valid portable output equals the canonical binding and that every malformed, out-of-scope or mismatched case is refused. The portable code stays standard-library only and keeps its existing contract versions.

Before any hashing or sealing, portable spec materialization refuses every sealed value that matches the canonical secret-like or local-absolute-path patterns, including reason, acceptance criteria, test-mapping purposes and nested provenance fields. Diagnostics name the offending field and never echo its value. Valid synthetic output and the existing seal formula and identity stay unchanged, and the tests use assembled synthetic values only.

The publication-safety CI job selects the explicit standard ubuntu-24.04 x64 runner instead of a moving label. It keeps the pinned Python 3.13.5 runtime, pinned action SHAs, locked dependency and model hashes, component-present setup, closed versus general dispatch and exact-source checks unchanged. A focused assertion against the actual workflow fails on the moving-label source and passes after the correction. The existing portable export/CI consumer also checks the publication job runner and Python pin. Actual exact-source required CI must pass, with no skip, attestation, runtime fallback or gate waiver.

A genuine approved native revision that changes only selector provenance, revision or evidence bookkeeping may reuse an original complete positive focused or interactions category result without invoking its command again. This requires identical selected criteria, mappings, scopes, commands, fixtures, catalog and runtime, an exact source ancestry, and unchanged non-selector source bytes and modes, declared dependencies, configuration, authority, environment and closed runtime-artifact inputs. Original record, output, stream and capture custody must also still verify. The reused result keeps its original commit, tree, contract, output and time with a distinct current applicability proof and nothing copied, resealed or relabeled. Sanity always executes fresh. Any changed source, test, fixture, dependency, configuration, catalog, criterion, mapping, command, runtime, environment, authority or origin; any missing, deleted, symlinked, untracked or staged drift; any orphaned, fake or unapproved revision; any changed record, output, stream or index; any partial, failing, skipped or cancelled result; or any unknown legacy closure refuses reuse. Current exact-tree admission behavior is unchanged.

Every unittest method of the category-content-reuse class runs as its own job through the existing exact-discovery isolated per-test cohort route. The per-job deadline stays at 120000 ms, concurrency stays at 4, and the supporting unittest fixture keeps its original bytes. Every declared test is discovered and executed exactly once, with unchanged source, mode, runtime, environment, output custody and terminal-report requirements. The class keeps the default class-level setup and teardown hooks. A missing, failed, timed-out or skipped unit still keeps the whole focused category from passing.

The customer-data scanner's phone-detection view removes only exact Node TAP newline-comment continuation framing that falls inside a complete quoted value of exactly nineteen decimal digits under an mtime_ns or ctime_ns key, including the scanner's existing escaped-quote representation, so the reassembled contiguous nineteen-digit value is not reported as a phone number. Every digit and every byte outside that framing is kept, and the email, secret, identifier and blocked-digest checks still read the unmodified original text. Committed synthetic tests built from reconstructed tokens must cover: splits at each digit position, LF and CRLF continuations, and escaped forms, which must not be reported; ordinary ten- and eleven-digit non-fictional phone numbers, unrelated keys, malformed, partial or non-nineteen-digit values, and true phone, email, secret or blocked-digest content adjacent to a normalized value, which must still be reported; and the existing bounded adversarial spacing-performance cases, which must keep passing. The change adds no path or key exemption, no general phone allowlist, no raw-evidence edit, no timeout or budget increase, and no change to worker policy or input binding.

During review-context preparation, a prior passing category capture whose applicability can no longer be proven (staged or committed non-selector source change, changed selection, runtime or origin, malformed record, or missing lineage) becomes an explicit invalid current validation with a non-empty reason. It is not raised as an uncaught data error, it grants no verified or reused entry, and it leaves original records and outputs byte-identical. Valid same-tree and selector-only applicability still verify. Only the expected data and projection error classes are normalized; cancellation, assertion and unrelated failures still propagate.

Category reuse refuses through an explicit validation error, never an operating-system error and never a reuse grant, when the original retained output of a candidate execution record is missing or unreadable; a genuine unchanged-test focused run fails before and passes after the correction with fixture bytes unchanged.

When the Claude reviewer process exits non-zero and its standard output is a JSON envelope, either a single object or an event list with exactly one result event, that reports an error with a non-empty result, the raised launcher error keeps the existing process-failure wording and diagnostics location and additionally names the reported reason, bounded to its last 2000 characters.

When the Claude reviewer process exits non-zero with non-JSON output, an envelope without an error flag or reason, or an event list without exactly one result event, the raised error is exactly the existing plain process-failure message with the diagnostics location; a non-zero exit always raises and never yields an answer, approval, retry or alternate engine, other-engine failures keep their existing message, and zero-exit error-envelope behavior is unchanged.

On the release-versioned tree, where the only changes beyond the sealed corrections are the next package patch-version advance and the regenerated release and client manifests, the refusal-normalization and reviewer failure-reason behaviors described by the other criteria hold unchanged, and no public API version is created or changed.

Verify exact inventory and selection rules, historical reconstruction, full-range admission and unchanged validation requirements.
Preserve native custody, incomplete-result handling, retained checkpoints and exact-candidate lifecycle admission.
Verify deterministic source and package consumers retain sealed-contract and publication boundaries.
Preserve component-artifact verification limits and refusal of unauthorized source promotion.
Verify the explicit-request and task-authority rule, preserved privacy and media safeguards, continuation payload limits and parity across every generated feedback consumer.
Verify single submission, fresh selected-context mutations, reporter authority, reply attribution and uncertain-result no-replay behavior.
Verify native component version advancement, exact dependency pins and historical-content constraints.
Verify cross-product dependency resolution and valid generated pins.
Verify package composition, data minimization and generated product boundaries.

Verify the settings caller uses an explicit reporting request or necessary in-scope authorized-task bug report without redundant confirmation, while unsolicited reports remain drafts and context/privacy boundaries stay intact.
Verify graph completion, compact route presentation and focused student-workflow scope are unchanged by dependent version-pin updates.
Verifies generic current app discovery agreement and strict legacy defaults without client route construction.
Verifies current app discovery propagation into journey discovery with trusted origins.
Verifies registration construction preserves the returned same-app opaque organization URI and unchanged current schemas.
Verifies descriptor-bound admission denial envelopes are preserved before lifecycle parsing without inferred recovery or replay.
Reproduces and verifies the bounded Git transport exemption while contacts and unsafe variants remain flagged.
Verifies privacy scanner coverage and policy identity across the changed sources.
Verifies callback readiness uses the propagated current app registration and real HTTPS host capability.
Verifies contract projection of current app registration and declared admission errors.
Verifies external dependency adaptation keeps current schemas and trusted origins.
Verifies generated journey package parity for the registration and dependency changes.
Verifies the dependent package keeps complete dependency closure after the workflow dependency fix.
Verifies command-coverage applicability, no rerun of covered commands, rejection of stale or foreign coverage, and failure propagation.
Verifies public Chroma tests honor the configured public Python with local fallback and locked model custody.
Verifies Oracle public structural core obligations.
Verifies immutable export and equivalent synthetic credential-negative rejection fixtures.
Verifies Oracle public benchmark obligations on the exported source.
Verifies Oracle public runner obligations.
Native-only live proposal obligation, never fabricated as public CI execution.
Verifies the locked Vault index runtime without automatic install or download.
Native execution selection, payload validation, exact action href preservation and fail-closed error envelopes in canonical and generated clients.
Generated-output proof regeneration, inventory equality and refusal of altered, stale or unsupported proof.
Parallel cohort partitioning, checkpoint adoption and generated-proof coverage recognition through the real controller.
Relocation chain admission, retirement refusal and fail-closed handling of malformed or concurrent chains.
Typed checkpoint journal replay, input binding and conflicting-observation handling.
Controller-to-series retention of observations and complete governing-text delivery without approval leakage.
Complete governing-text bundle provenance and fail-closed handling of missing or altered governance.
Cohort size and concurrency bounds with complete declared case execution.
Source-frontier assignment and complete-coverage accounting.
Release push event admission and gate-base resolution with legacy refs untouched.
Release ref format enforcement across preparation, validation and publication admission, executing every declared case.
End-to-end release workflow with exact-source CI, leased promotion and remote readback.
Proves that history-integrity admission refuses rewriting, dropping or replacing recorded commits and keeps prepared ancestors valid through descendant work.
Checks the published build definition and its publication-safety admission.

selection.reason: Additive revision after integrating the published release. It appends one narrow correction: review-context preparation records a stale or unprovable category-capture applicability as an explicit invalid current validation instead of raising, and category reuse refuses through a normal error when the original output is missing. It also keeps the published reviewer failure-reason criteria as native acceptance in the merged successor. The next package patch release (version files and regenerated client and release manifests) adds no behavior and creates no public API version. New reproduction cases go into the already selected focused suite; all prior criteria, categories and mappings are retained.
